headline: South Korea’s Stock Market Emerges as Purest Play on Artificial Intelligence
summary: South Korea's stock market has drawn attention from investors as a key proxy for artificial intelligence exposure due to its heavy weighting in semiconductor and tech manufacturing.
why: Regional market composition determines how international investors allocate capital to capture specific thematic trends like global AI infrastructure growth.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Strong global demand for AI-related hardware positions South Korean technology and memory chip manufacturers as core beneficiaries.
